A interface for holding changes to apply. This is considered a new level within the level system

    • copyLinkedChangesInto

      default void copyLinkedChangesInto(@NotNull Self self)
      Copies the changes that are not directly applied to this instance, but this instance will hold the object of. This will not remove any changes unless the new changes directly conflict with the previous changes, to which the changes will be compared and one will be dropped
      Parameters:
      self - The level to apply the changes to

    • compareDirectChanges

      @CheckReturnValue @Range(from=0L,to=2147483647L) int compareDirectChanges(@NotNull Self compare)
      Compares the changes that are directly applied to this instance. This is designed to be used as either '< 0' or '0 >' in the same way that the typical compares work. However, the result may not be -1, 0 or 1 but instead a different number. All direct changes are compared and the negative results and summed up and the positives are summed up, from there the two results are compared (as if both were positive numbers) with the winner being the result
      Parameters:
      compare - instance to compare to
      Returns:
      differences between

    • compareLinkedChanges

      @CheckReturnValue default int compareLinkedChanges(@NotNull Self compare)
      Compares the changes that are indirectly applied to this instance. This is designed to be used as either '< 0' or '0 >' in the same way that the typical compares work. However, the result may not be -1, 0 or 1 but instead a different number. All direct changes are compared and the negative results and summed up and the positives are summed up, from there the two results are compared (as if both were positive numbers) with the winner being the result
      Parameters:
      compare - instance to compare to
      Returns:
      differences between

    • commitDirectChanges

      @Range(from=0L,to=2147483647L) int commitDirectChanges()
      Commits all direct changes to the parent with the result being the amount of changes that have been successfully commited. This also removes the changes from this instance

      Note: If a change was rejected (typically due to it being compared with a conflicting change and loosing the compare) it will not be within the result but will be removed.

      Returns:
      The amount of changes that were successfully commited
